# Starship Cargo — MOVIE PREPRODUCTION DRAFT v0.1

**Status:** screenplay BEAT DRAFT and proposed shot/animatic timing only. **No film shots, voice tracks, animatic video, 3D rigs, audio mix or completed movie generated by this document.**

**Source of truth:** `assets/platform-worlds.js` game-specific hero, 6 stage names, opening, ending and traversal identity. All shot layouts require checking with the actual playable stage before render. No copyrighted counterpart maps, character likenesses, gameplay recordings or music.

**Lead:** Whisker. **Mechanic:** run-and-gun cover and separated firing lanes. **Canonical cast:** Whisker and Luna remain best friends; no romantic subplot. All hero designs must match the approved Super Paw Heroes master poster and its character sheets (not independently reimagined). **Voices:** use approved voices only once available; Whisker's higher-pitched young male voice is still pending final approval. **Narrator:** warm fatherly delivery, only at opening and ending.

## Timed screenplay / storyboard plan (approximate 23:55 narrative + credits)

**Shot A:** Establish original location in wide cinematic 3D render framed for Android 800×380 landscape reference. Camera preserves lateral gameplay direction but adds real modeled depth and volumetric light.

**Narrator (only at opening here):** “Every great adventure starts with someone who sees a problem and decides to help. Tonight, Whisker has a promise to keep.”

**Onscreen action:** Whisker enters a drifting freighter to launch a rescue pod before the airlock closes.

**Music/SFX:** commission or create an original $0-license instrumental score. Voice selection, dialogue mix, captions and facial timing pending.

## Required production checks

- Replace draft beats with approved complete screenplay and stage-accurate storyboard; verify actual stage environments and encounters first.
- Create fully original character rigs, model/texture/lighting passes, individualized hero/enemy movement and weight, and facial lip-sync in a free 3D suite (subject to availability).
- Render high-quality, optimized shots; separately edit sound, approved dialogue, narrator open/close and original music, and captions.
- Validate playback (audio + captions), copyright/voice approvals, safe assets, and final site link. A finished playable video cannot be claimed until those checks pass.
